ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_pairwise_regret_rank_logsigmoid
ir.intuition: Shift from smooth margin or contrastive losses to a ranking regret paradigm by integrating delta_rank with log-probability differences using a logsigmoid link. This loss penalizes incorrect ordinal ranking weighted by pairwise regret, emphasizing pairs where rank discrepancies matter most and directly optimizing ranking quality with a nonlinear sensitivity to log-prob differences.
ir.pseudocode:
delta_rank = batch['delta_rank']
l_diff = batch['log_prob_w'] - batch['log_prob_l']
regret_penalty = ops.relu(delta_rank)
weighted_score = regret_penalty * l_diff
loss_vector = -ops.logsigmoid(weighted_score)
if weight is not None:
  loss_vector = loss_vector * weight
loss = ops.mean(loss_vector)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', None)
    delta_rank = batch['delta_rank']

    l_diff = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    regret_penalty = ops.relu(delta_rank)
    weighted_score = ops.mul(regret_penalty, l_diff)
    loss_vec = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(weighted_score))

    if weight is not None:
        loss_vec = ops.mul(loss_vec, weight)
    return ops.mean(loss_vec)
